title: Design, synthesis, and molecular modeling of coumarin derivatives as MDM2 inhibitors targeting breast cancer.
authors: Ahmed, Eman Y; Abdel Latif, Nehad A; Nasr, Tamer; Awad, Hanem M; Abdelhafez, Omaima M
one_liner_zh: 该文设计合成香豆素类MDM2抑制剂并做分子对接，但对象是蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，仅分子对接方法可借鉴，与TF-DNA课题关系疏远。
abstract: The coumarin ring was used as a central scaffold that was substituted with a variety of bioactive functional groups, for designing and synthesizing novel MDM2 inhibitors targeting breast cancer. The synthesized derivatives, 3c, 3d, 3g, 7b, 7c and 8 with IC(50s) ranging from 9.4 to 9.9 microM were evaluated for their safety on MCF10a normal breast cell line. The compounds showed selectivity indices of 2.15, 3.85, 2.75, 1.38, 3.72 and 5.20 respectively. 7c was selected for further investigation, the compound was capable of down-regulating MDM2 and the anti-apoptosis proteins Bcl-2 and Bcl-xL, up-regulating the level of p53 and the pro-apoptosis protein BAX, causing cell cycle arrest at G2/M phase and activating Caspase-9 to induce apoptosis. Molecular docking study revealed the capability of derivative 7c to interact with the key amino acids in p53 binding pocket of MDM2 protein. Moreover, the physicochemical properties of compound 7c were studied in silico.
abstract_zh: 以香豆素环为中心骨架，并取代多种生物活性官能团，用于设计并合成靶向乳腺癌的新型MDM2抑制剂。合成的衍生物3c、3d、3g、7b、7c和8，其IC(50)值范围为9.4至9.9微摩尔，在MCF10a正常乳腺细胞系上评估了其安全性。这些化合物的选择性指数分别为2.15、3.85、2.75、1.38、3.72和5.20。选择7c进行进一步研究，该化合物能够下调MDM2及抗凋亡蛋白Bcl-2和Bcl-xL，上调p53和促凋亡蛋白BAX的水平，导致细胞周期阻滞于G2/M期，并激活Caspase-9以诱导凋亡。分子对接研究揭示了衍生物7c与MDM2蛋白p53结合口袋中关键氨基酸相互作用的能力。此外，通过计算机模拟研究了化合物7c的理化性质。
